messages.author: b7832cf09ba80064
messages.subject: qplot  - how to remove margins?
parts:
Hi,

i am trying to remove the margins of a plot created qith qplot using
following statement:

p <- qplot(waves$Time[waves$Hexagon==i],waves$Amplitude[waves
$Hexagon==i],
geom='line',margin=FALSE) +
labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = NA) +
scale_y_continuous(breaks = NA)

Using plot i can remove the margins with par(mar=c(0,0,0,0)) which
works. With qplot the labels and ticks can be removed, but the margin
remains.

How do i get rid of the margins?

Thanks,
Herbert

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: qplot - how to remove margins?
parts:
Hi,

looking at the book (p. 153), i think you want,

opts(plot.margin = unit(rep(0, 4), "lines"))

library(ggplot2)
p =qplot(1,1)+xlab("")+ylab("")
p2 = p + opts(plot.margin = unit(rep(0, 4), "lines"))

grid.newpage()
vp1=viewport(y=0.25,height=0.5)
print(p,vp=vp1)
grid.rect(vp=vp1)
vp2=viewport(y=0.75,height=0.5)
print(p2 ,vp=vp2)
grid.rect(vp=vp2)


HTH,

baptiste
